name: colonova-confluence-kit
description: ColoNova Engineering Confluence document routing, audit, and publishing skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route, publish, and audit ColoNova Confluence docs
interface.longDescription: Two focused skills for the ColoNova Engineering Confluence tree: colonova-folder-audit performs read-only tree audits and execution queue planning, while colonova-doc-router-publisher routes drafts, rewrites them with templates, and publishes only after explicit approval with readback verification.
defaultPrompt: Audit the 8.8 ColoNova Confluence tree for archive and placement candidates
Route this ColoNova draft to the right Confluence folder and rewrite it
Prepare a publish-ready ColoNova Confluence document package
